arguments.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf project/src/eywa/__pycache__ project/tests/__pycache__ 2>/dev/null; find project -type f -o -type d | sort; echo "---"; python3 -c "
import os
total=0; entries=0
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('/workspace/project'):
    for d in dirs:
        entries += 1
        p = os.path.join(root,d)
        assert not os.path.islink(p), p
    for f in files:
        entries += 1
        p = os.path.join(root,f)
        assert not os.path.islink(p), p
        total += os.path.getsize(p)
print('entries', entries, 'bytes', total, 'limit', 8*1024*1024)
"
